# Quantum Branding
> Quantum Branding is the independent brand strategy practice of Nizzar Ben Chekroune, across Brand x AI x Business. Its client method is The Collapse: Observe, Collapse, Build, Hold.
## What it does
Brand and positioning, marketing and sales, digital and experience, AI and intelligent systems, for companies with something important to improve, launch, rethink or build. Work is direct with Nizzar Ben Chekroune.
